facts.fact: Max 报出新情报：妹妹已不在 Crimson Ridge，被 Collector 带走了。
facts.anchor: My sister isn’t in Crimson Ridge anymore. The Collector has her.

facts.fact: 幻象中被割下的人头对 Max 说：Xander 已经知道她的一切，并把 Missy 关进了 Haven。
facts.anchor: He has your sister in the Haven.

facts.fact: Max 描述人头的外观特征：左眼下方有三星形状的小胎记，Aelindor 据此对上画像。
facts.anchor: There was a birthmark under her left eye. Small. Shaped like a three-pointed star.

facts.fact: Aelindor 认证这是 Oracle：被 Xander 捕杀后割头，用黑魔法保持存活，只准自己一人听她的幻视。
facts.anchor: After Xander captured her, he killed her. Severed her head, kept it alive with dark magic

facts.fact: Aelindor 点破 Oracle 的动机：它不是设陷阱，而是求 Max 赐它求之不得的死亡。
facts.anchor: She reached out to Max because Max may grant her the death she longs for.

facts.fact: Drakken 推演绑匪路线：收买守卫抓人后西进内华达、南穿亚利桑达到新墨西哥边界、进入德州 Xander 地盘。
facts.anchor: They could go west into Nevada, south through Arizona to the New Mexico border, then into Xander’s territory in Texas.

facts.fact: Max 用 Delia 连环讥讽 Drakken 后，他反而大笑，点破她是在吃醋。
Aelindor 拦下 Max 的独行计划：先核实 Missy 下落与关押地点，不许盲目冲进敌境。
facts.anchor: You won’t go alone, love, because you’re not alone anymore
